title: Jazz Dot Com
style: Future bass fused with jazz harmony: lush extended chords on Rhodes and detuned soft-synth pads, chopped vocal-style lead on a plucky FM synth, and syncopated 808 sub-bass with sidechain pumping. Live ride cymbal, ghost-note snare, brushed percussion, and upright bass accents keep it fluid and warm.
